description: Simulated binary data with no, one and several planted splits.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 800L
    d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), z1 = runif(n, -1, 1), z2 = factor(sample(c("p", "q", "r"), n, replace = TRUE)), 
        z3 = factor(sample(c("lo", "mid", "high", "top"), n, replace = TRUE), levels = c("lo", "mid", 
            "high", "top"), ordered = TRUE), z4 = rnorm(n))
    u <- runif(n)
    d$y_null <- as.integer(u < plogis(-0.3 + 1 * d$x))
    d$y_one <- as.integer(u < plogis(ifelse(d$z1 <= 0, -1 + 1.5 * d$x, 1 - 1.5 * d$x)))
    eta <- ifelse(d$z2 == "r", -1 + 1.5 * d$x, ifelse(d$z1 <= 0.3, 0.8 - 1 * d$x, -0.8 + 0.5 * d$x))
    d$y_multi <- as.integer(u < plogis(eta))
    d
}
